original_title: Super fast nucleation/crystallization during spin-coating perovskite
title: Super fast nucleation/crystallization during spin-coating perovskite
blurb: Hey, I am reaching out to people who work on spin-coating and perovskites/similar. I have recently run into an issue where my thin films seem to crystallize so rapidly that instead of a continuous film, it forms very small particles all over the substrate. From SEM and AFM it looks like these are "eating up" the film. I have been using DMSO as solvent, but I have also tried DMF:DMSO mixture, with a similar if not worse outcome. original_title: [Nature] Bunsen burners’ reputation for sterilizing workplaces flames out
title: [Nature] Bunsen burners’ reputation for sterilizing workplaces flames out
blurb: Recently read about this topic in Nature and I was surprised no one has still talked about this in here or any of the microbiology-related subreddits. What's your take? Personally, if this study is as true as it seems, I have been fooled all my career long. Article TL;DR: "A recent study has debunked the long-standing laboratory myth that Bunsen burners help sterilize workbenches by creating protective updrafts.
